independentReview.conclusion: 18 articles pass subject to source-access limits recorded below; T263 requires final review of the corrected wording before adoption; T289 remains review because its newspaper advertisement could not be independently retrieved and its current draft generalizes from one page.

findings.finding: The National Museum of Denmark catalog records a British-made 1952 parka. “M 1951” is text on its interior label, not an independently established identity of the object as a US M-1951 parka.
findings.response: Revised the article to identify the collection object as a British-made 1952 parka, quote the sewn-in label separately, and neutralize the period metadata. Keep status review pending final exact-head confirmation.
